name: CARLA Autonomous Driving Leaderboard
description: An autonomous driving leaderboard for evaluating end-to-end driving agents and modular driving stacks in the CARLA simulator across standardized scenarios and routes.
evaluation_method: route completion, infraction penalties, driving score, and scenario success rates in simulation
notes: Leaderboards typically evaluate closed-loop behavior in simulation rather than offline perception alone. Performance can vary significantly with scenario distribution and simulator settings.
